description: This file defines API views for a product management system, including a health check endpoint and a ProductViewSet that provides CRUD operations and a custom total balance calculation for products.

classes.name: ProductViewSet
classes.description: A viewset providing CRUD operations for Product, including a custom action to compute total inventory balance.

methods.name: health
methods.description: A simple health check endpoint that returns a message indicating the server is running.

methods.name: total_balance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total monetary value of all products (price * quantity) as a decimal string.
